prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier judging a wine recommender. A customer
with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Can I try a light wine from New Zealand that tastes like red berries and coffee?"

The recommender suggested these 5 wines (described by a professional
tasting note):

Wine 1: Red Blend, Italy, $50. Tasting note: "Aromas of black currant, menthol, oak and vanilla lead the nose. The extracted, one-dimensional palate offers prune, blackberry extract, dried sage and tobacco alongside extremely raspy, astringent tannins that dry out the palate."
Wine 2: Cabernet Sauvignon, US, $48. Tasting note: "Black-olive tapenade is the star of this show, along with fig, black currant and cedar. Bittersweet cocoa accents the powerful tannin and integrated oak, before finishing velvety smooth."
Wine 3: Merlot-Cabernet Franc, US, $45. Tasting note: "Light red-fruit flavors are spiced up beautifully with cinnamon and sweet toast. This is an elegant, peppery wine that's well defined and still showing some youthful sharpness. It will reward additional bottle age and should cellar well for up to a decade."
Wine 4: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $10. Tasting note: "This simple, ripe and fruity wine is destined for early drinking. It has rich dark plum fruits, a sprinkling of tannins and a fine juicy character. Very ready to drink now."
Wine 5: Rhône-style Red Blend, France, $13. Tasting note: "This blend of 45% Cinsault, 45% Carignan and 10% Syrah offers vanilla-kissed aromas of blackberry, raspberry and plum, as well as a touch of menthol. The slightly creamy, full-flavored palate boasts ripe black-fruit flavors and a touch of milk chocolate, all of which linger through to the medium-length finish."

Rate how well each wine matches the request, using this scale:
5 = matches every wish in the request
4 = matches the main wishes, misses a minor one
3 = partly matches: right kind of wine but several wishes missed, or the reverse
2 = matches only a small part of the request
1 = does not match (wrong kind of wine, or contradicts a wish)
Judge only from the information given. A wish the information cannot
confirm (for example a price that is unknown) is neither a match nor a
mismatch.

Then rate the set:
- set_relevance: how useful the 5 wines are together as an answer to the request (1-5).

Think briefly about each wine before scoring it. Answer with JSON only, in
this form:
{"wines": [{"reason": "<one sentence>", "relevance": <1-5>}, ... one per wine, in order],
 "set_relevance": <1-5>}
